overview.description: The Harbor International Equity ETF (EPIN) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed to invest in equity securities of companies in developed markets outside the US, utilizing a disciplined approach to identify undervalued stocks with strong fundamentals. The fund aims for long-term total return. EPIN was launched on Jun 4, 2025 and is issued by Harbor.
